question.text: Identity and beneficial ownership records under PMLA Section 12 must be maintained for:

answer.text: 5 years after business relationship ends or account closed, whichever is later

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 12 mandates 5 years after business relationship ends or account closes. The Trap: Lifetime or 1-year periods misread the rule. Cross-Exam Context: Same in XXIV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Auto-archive closed-client records with a 5-year retention clock.
